candidate_relations.reason: Discoid LE is a superficial cutaneous LE variant without the deep panniculitic component that is the defining histopathologic feature here (lobular panniculitis, hyaline fat necrosis). The linear/annular scalp panniculitis entity is a distinct subtype of LE panniculitis, not DLE.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Lupus erythematosus family but missing the panniculitis (profundus) subtype and the linear/annular morphology specific to LALPS

candidate_relations.reason: Linear morphea can produce linear furrows and alopecia but the histopathology (lobular panniculitis, hyaline fat necrosis) and DIF pattern (granular IgG, IgA, IgM, C3, C1q, fibrinogen in dermal vessels) are incompatible with morphea and instead point to LE panniculitis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Linear morphea is a fibrosing disorder; histology would show sclerosis/fibrosis, not lobular panniculitis with lymphocytic infiltrates and positive DIF for multiple immunoreactants in dermal vessels

candidate_relations.reason: Lichen planopilaris shows perifollicular lichenoid infiltrate at the isthmus level without lobular panniculitis or hyaline fat necrosis, and DIF typically shows cytoid bodies/fibrinogen at the BMZ rather than granular multi-immunoreactant deposits in dermal vessels.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: LPP is a lymphocytic cicatricial alopecia of the follicular isthmus; it lacks panniculitis and the DIF pattern seen here

case_quality_flags: Reference diagnosis is a rare, well-defined entity (LALPS); none of the three candidates captures the panniculitis subtype or linear/annular scalp-specific designation
